dominant_strengths: Bold wordmark treatment with the red 'cal' accent creates clear brand recall and an iconic focal point
Clean top navigation with proper hierarchy, signed-in CTA, and clear product separation feels native to Apple ecosystem
Generous whitespace around the headline allows the calendar superpowers message to land without competition
dominant_weaknesses: Decorative app-icon squares on both sides feel decorative rather than functional, crowding the hero and fighting the wordmark
Color palette is loud and uncoordinated — rainbow squares, red logo accent, blue CTA, all competing without a unifying system
Typography is generic system sans with weak rhythm; subhead and body lack scale contrast and feel undersized vs the massive logo
fix_priorities: Tame or remove the floating colored squares — reduce opacity, count, or confine to a single side to restore focus
Establish a tighter color system: pick 2 accents max and let the calendar icon carry the chromatic story
Strengthen typographic hierarchy with a distinctive display face and tighter scale ratios between H1/sub/body
Replace the generic stock-style video frame below with a real product screenshot to build credibility
rationale.norman_balance: Leans visceral via colorful chrome but the noise undermines reflective polish and behavioral clarity is only average.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads as a Fantastical marketing page but the busy decorative frame undercuts the precision and refinement the actual Mac app is known for.
